value.rationale: Solves exactly the single-forbidden-scattered-subsequence MCS variant explicitly posed in the 2026 source, for arbitrary finite numbers of strings, with a tight rank-max identity, a simple linear-time feasibility/witness construction, and constructive inclusion-minimality.
